item.title: Lawrence city commissioners approve historic markers to honor teens killed by police in 1970
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday approved historic markers to pay tribute to Rick "Tiger" Dowdell and Nick Rice, teens who were shot and killed by Lawrence police officers in 1970, despite objections from the police chief. Continue reading ...

item.title: City, county World Cup prep team to host social media trainings for Douglas County businesses
item.description: The Lawrence area’s World Cup prep team will host social media workshops for Douglas County businesses to gain visibility and customers as the KC metro area experiences a flood of tourism. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence has hit goal for paid rec center memberships but might not reach projected revenue
item.description: Although the city has netted its goal of total paid rec center memberships, that doesn’t mean its revenue goal is a shoo-in. Continue reading ...

item.title: Forty individuals, organizations object to Kansas Senate bill adding barriers to food and health aid
item.description: Melissa Sabin and dozens of others opposed a Kansas Senate bill that would aggressively expand the state’s process of verifying eligibility for Medicaid, SNAP and other public assistance programs. Continue reading ...

item.title: Courthouse, rec centers, city offices to close for Presidents Day
item.description: City rec centers, Douglas County District Court and more will be closed Monday for Presidents Day, but downtown parking will be free and trash pickup will occur as scheduled. Here are more notes and details for the holiday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Mardi Gras parade to jazz up Mass Street on Fat Tuesday

item.title: Lawrence Cultural Arts Commission selects artist for Vermont Street garage mural
item.description: The Lawrence Cultural Arts Commission on Wednesday selected a mural proposal from Tokeya Waci U Richardson, Oglala Lakota and Haliwa-Saponi, to adorn a wall of the Vermont Street parking garage. Continue reading ...
